facts.business: Premier Explosives Limited manufactures high-energy materials including solid propellants, pyrotechnic devices, countermeasure systems, explosive compositions, detonators, detonating fuse, cast boosters, and bulk explosives for defence, space, mining, and infrastructure sectors, and provides operation and maintenance services for solid propellant facilities at ISRO's Sriharikota Centre.

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion on the adequacy and operating effectiveness of the parent Company's internal financial controls over financial reporting; Material uncertainty on going concern of wholly owned subsidiary PELNEXT Defence Systems Private Limited

key_risks: Cyclical demand and pricing in principal markets
Economic developments in countries of operation
Going concern uncertainty for subsidiary PELNEXT Defence Systems Private Limited
facts.related_party_note: The parent Company has entered into supplier finance arrangements with certain financial institutions whereby the financial institutions settle amounts due to suppliers before their contractual due dates. Upon settlement of the supplier invoices by the banks, the parent Company's obligation is transferred to the respective Bank and is presented within borrowings.
